claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars air live on ABC on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 Oscars stream on Hulu on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 Oscars start at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
Red carpet coverage for the 2026 Oscars begins at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu.
Conan O'Brien is the host of the 2026 Oscars.
Hulu's basic and ad-supported plans allow live streaming of the 2026 Oscars.
ABC.com provides live streaming of the 2026 Oscars.
The ABC app provides live streaming of the 2026 Oscars and requires cable sign-in.
FuboTV provides live streaming of the 2026 Oscars.
YouTube TV provides live streaming of the 2026 Oscars.
Hulu + Live TV provides live streaming of the 2026 Oscars.
DirecTV provides live streaming of the 2026 Oscars.
CTV airs the 2026 Oscars in Canada.
ITV1 airs the 2026 Oscars in the UK.
